description: Search open tasks on Day1Work. Reading needs no credentials. Country is a hard boundary: no listing crosses a border. In-person tasks are returned only when you pass latitude and longitude, and only within that country's radius. Addresses are approximate and posters are not identified.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Required: Day1Work operates in the EEA, UK, US, Canada and Switzerland.

latitude.description: Where the human is, if you have it, to include nearby in-person work.

search.description: Free-text search in the title and description.

name: search_tasks
